messages:
mia_sales: CardioSync asks for a HIPAA POC. Traffic profile: baseline 150 qps, predictable 10m spikes to 700 qps (avg ~85 tokens), plus rare sudden blips to 1k qps. They want a quoted reserved plan, preheat steps, autoscale snippet, and a conditional p99 SLA. Need by COB Thurs.

cale_eng: Quick numbers: our medium-A100 quantized setup is ~240 qps/GPU @85 tokens. For 700 steady spike => 3 GPUs, with 1 extra burst credit for blips. Recommend reserved_gpus:3 + burst_credits:1.

juna_sre: Agree. KV shards = 6 (2 per GPU) and preheat = 18m before predicted window. For predictable spikes we can stagger warmups in 3 waves to steady KV load. Also recommend AZ spread=2.

rae_prod: Add degraded fallback: gpt-chat-compact-int8 to preserve availability if burst credits exhausted. Route: reserved -> burst -> degraded_shared. We'll instrument quality gating for fallbacks.

ops_tom: Ops knobs: global_rate_limit:1200qps, queue_depth_max:450. Add token-based fair-queueing and an emergency shedding policy for anonymous traffic. Preheat example for docs: `redwood preheat --project cardiosync-poc --model gpt-chat-quant --shards 6 --duration 18m --stagger 60s`

cale_eng: Autoscale snippet for SOW: `autoscale: reserved_gpus: "3", burst_credits: "1", preheat_minutes: "18", kv_shards: "6", scale_up: "target_util:65%, cooldown_s:20", scale_down: "grace_s:180", degraded_model: "gpt-chat-compact-int8"`

juna_sre: SLA wording: "Redwood commits to p99 < 240ms when serving from reserved capacity (3 GPUs) with KV warmed and no evictions. If serving from burst credits or degraded model, p99 may increase to 350-700ms. SOW will include rollback triggers."

legal_lee: For HIPAA we need BAA, KMS (customer-managed supported), audit logs >=90d, and explicit data residency note. Mia, forward their security packet and we'll prepare answers.

mia_sales: Sent questionnaire via DM. I'll put reserved_gpus:3, burst_credits:1, preheat:18m, queue knobs, and SLA caveat into the draft SOW.

preheat-bot: Placeholder scheduled: cardiosync-poc / preheat / 2024-11-06T07:40Z :white_check_mark:

mia_sales: Thanks team — will follow up with cost ballpark once finance confirms daily run-rate.
